newsitem.title: CANADA: Koch Oil raises Canada posted oil prices.
newsitem.headline: Koch Oil raises Canada posted oil prices.

text.p: Koch Oil Co Ltd said it raised the price it would pay for Edmonton light sweet crude oil by C$3.00/cubic metre or C$0.48/barrel, to C$171.00/cubic metre or C$27.19/barrel, effective immediately.
Other new prices were listed as follows:
Cromer light sour C$159.00/cubic metre, or C$25.28/barrel
Bow River at Hardisty C$129.00/cubic metre, or C$20.51/barrel
Hardisty medium C$144.00/cubic metre, or C$22.89/barrel
Midale at Cromer C$141.00/cubic metre, or C$22.42/barrel
